name: Wave Reimagined
description: A reimagining of the wave gamemode.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master enable. Disabling this goes back to the lame, boring old wave trail.

base-size.name: Blade thickness
base-size.description: Scales the resting width of the wave trail. <cy>1</c> is the normal width, lower is thinner, higher is thicker.

pulse-multiplier.name: Music pulse
pulse-multiplier.description: How strongly the wave trail pulses (gets thicker) on the beat of the music. <cy>0</c> keeps the blade a constant width, <cy>1</c> is the normal amount, <cy>2</c> is double.

glow-size.name: Glow size
glow-size.description: How far the coloured glow reaches out from the trail, in units. <cy>0</c> hides the glow entirely.

glow-strength.name: Glow strength
glow-strength.description: Brightness of the glow right at the edge of the trail, where it's most intense before fading to transparent.

music-glow.name: Music-reactive glow
music-glow.description: Makes the glow flare brighter with the music on top of its normal strength. louder = more intense. <cy>0</c> is off, higher values flare harder with the beat.

fix-wave-angle.name: Fix wave drift
fix-wave-angle.description: Forces the wave to move at an exact 45 degree angle, fixing the vanilla bug where it drifts between ~44.9 and ~45.1. <cr>This changes the game's physics</c>, so it is OFF by default and should NOT be used for legitimate top-play submissions like pointercrate.
